brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Spain’s election could see Europe’s far-right ‘firewall’ begin to fall apart. [1]
A far-right kingmaker could emerge from the elections in Spain. [4]

KEY RISKS
Spain's reliance on the Strait of Gibraltar, a shipping chokepoint World Monitor tracks, poses a risk to its energy imports. [E4]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Spain, "Will Pedro Sánchez be the next Prime Minister of Spain?", priced Yes at 11% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes Nov 30, 2026. [E5]
A Polymarket market related to Spain, "Spain General Election: PP + Vox Majority?", priced Yes at 86% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes Nov 30, 2026. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the far-right becomes a kingmaker after the elections in Spain. [4]
